$description: DeckStreak's design tokens, in the DTCG format 2025.10 (ADR-028). The ref tier holds raw colours: the Tide palette, whose values the page shows outside Telegram. The color tier names each role, maps it onto the Telegram theme parameter whose --tg-theme-* variable the client sets inside Telegram, and names the Tide role it falls back to outside Telegram. scripts/build-tokens.ts compiles this file into the CSS custom properties Tailwind's @theme reads. The modes tier holds DeckStreak's own Tide palette by mode, which Telegram's theme does not paint.

ref.$description: Raw colours. Only the color and modes tiers read them.

tide.$description: The Tide product palette's raw colours: a deep blue-black, a teal, and the neutral steps between white and the blue-black. The modes tier aliases them, and each colour role aliases the light value of its Tide role.

color.$description: Semantic roles. Each reads the Telegram theme parameter its deck-streak extension's telegram names. Outside Telegram it falls back to the Tide role its extension's tide names: the light value in :root, which its $value aliases, and the dark value under .dark. A text colour lists under text-on the backgrounds it is drawn on, and each such pair meets WCAG 2.2 AA in both of Telegram's default palettes and outside Telegram (tokens.test.ts).

foreground.$description: Body text, and the text of a link.

card.$description: A raised surface on the page, such as a panel. Every card also carries the border role.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text on the page, never on a card: Telegram's light hint colour on its secondary background is under 4.5:1.

link.$description: The underline of a link, never its text: Telegram's link colour on its background is under 4.5:1 in both default palettes.

border.$description: Rules, outlines and the edge of every card.

modes.$description: DeckStreak's product palette by mode: each role aliases a raw colour in ref.tide. The compile emits each as its own custom property, and Telegram's theme paints none of them.

background.$description: The page in the dark mode.

ink.$description: Text and icons on the background in the dark mode.

accent.$description: The accent on the background in the dark mode.

card.$description: A raised surface in the dark mode.

muted.$description: Secondary text on the background and on a card in the dark mode.

border.$description: Rules, outlines and the edge of a card in the dark mode.

background.$description: The page in the light mode.

ink.$description: Text and icons on the background in the light mode.

accent.$description: The accent on the background in the light mode.

card.$description: A raised surface in the light mode.

muted.$description: Secondary text on the background and on a card in the light mode.

border.$description: Rules, outlines and the edge of a card in the light mode.

radius.$description: The base corner radius; Tailwind's radius scale in layout.css derives from it.

sans.$description: The interface face. CJK text takes its own stack from cjk.css.
